Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Spices Board to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Spices Board Trainee (QEL Chemistry) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Spices Board Trainee (QEL Chemistry) recruitment is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Science Degree with Chemistry as a major subject or a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry from a recognized university or equivalent to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) post in the Spices Board Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) post is 30 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Trainee (QEL Chemistry) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Spices Board Trainee (QEL Chemistry) recruitment will primarily involve a written test. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Spices Board Trainee (QEL Chemistry) recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the Spices Board Trainee (QEL Chemistry) recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Spices Board located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a position in Puttady, Kerala, with the pincode 685551. This is the location where the selected candidates will likely be posted.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Trainee (QEL Chemistry) position is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the Spices Board.
